name: Pirlindole
summary: Pirlindole, sold under the brand names Lifril and Pyrazidol, is mainly a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA) and secondly a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) which was developed and is used in Russia as an antidepressant. It is structurally and pharmacologically related to metralindole.

pharmacology.text: Pirlindole, sold under the brand names Lifril and Pyrazidol, is mainly a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA) and secondly a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) which was developed and is used in Russia as an antidepressant.

uses.text: Pirlindole, sold under the brand names Lifril and Pyrazidol, is mainly a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA) and secondly a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) which was developed and is used in Russia as an antidepressant.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include dry mouth, sweating, tremor, dizziness, sleep problems and a fast heartbeat. Because it raises serotonin, it carries a risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 已知副作用包括口乾、出汗、顫抖、頭暈、睡眠問題和心跳加快。由於它會提高血清素，有引發血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知副作用包括口干、出汗、颤抖、头晕、睡眠问题和心跳加快。由于它会提高血清素，有引发血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: Pirlindole was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s under the name Pyrazidol. It has a four-ring structure, unlike the three-ring antidepressants common at the time.
fact.zh: Pirlindole 是 1970 年代在蘇聯以 Pyrazidol 之名開發的。它有四環結構，和當時常見的三環抗憂鬱藥不同。
fact.zhHans: Pirlindole 是 1970 年代在苏联以 Pyrazidol 之名开发的。它有四环结构，和当时常见的三环抗忧郁药不同。
